title: Codec variants: message history, utility targets and dropout against the confirmed codec
description: Step 3 of the plan (docs/methodology.md): what could raise the codec's skill, each change alone against the confirmed settings of release exp-codec-confirm-4 (learning rate 1e-3, width 512, encoder depth 4, weight decay 1e-4, all training anchors of release exp-phase0-steps-2, 10 epochs, links split 70/15/15 with split seed 0). Variants: frames4, the encoder reads the last 4 messages in place of 1; utility, the decoder also predicts the utility's terms (targets obs+utility); drop0.1 and drop0.3, dropout in the encoder and decoder, because the confirmed fixed-width models fit the training links better than the validation links. Each variant runs at two widths with every latent kept, 8 latents (fixed8) and 64 (wide64), seeds 0 to 2; the baselines are fixed8 and wide64 of exp-codec-confirm-4. Scores are on validation links only; the test links are not read.
run: VARIANT=${JOB%%-*}; REST=${JOB#*-}; MODEL=${REST%-s*}; SEED=${JOB##*-s}; case "$MODEL" in fixed8) K=8;; wide64) K=64;; *) exit 2;; esac; case "$VARIANT" in frames4) EXTRA='frames=4';; utility) EXTRA='targets="obs+utility"';; drop*) EXTRA="dropout=${VARIANT#drop}";; *) exit 2;; esac; uv run python experiments/codec.py train "$OUT/runs/$JOB" --data "$IN/steps" --set "$EXTRA" --set k=$K --set nested=false --set seed=$SEED --set lr=0.001 --set width=512 --set depth=4 --set dec_width=512 --set weight_decay=0.0001 --set epochs=10 --set time_budget_s=18000
collect: uv run python experiments/codec_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/runs/*; find "$OUT/runs" -name model.pt -delete
